blocks.text: Small curiosities a new character might carry. Roll on the table or choose freely; trinkets have no rules effect of their own.
blocks.title: Roll Drauf reading note

blocks.text: When you make your character, you can roll once on the Trinkets table to gain a Tiny trinket, a simple item lightly touched by mystery. The GM might also use this table. It can help stock a room in a dungeon or fill a creature’s pockets.
